en: Black‑and‑white view of a quiet European street with two‑ and three‑storey masonry houses with steep tiled roofs. A church with a tall, narrow spire rises in the background. In the foreground right stands a corner building with stucco façade and several windows; signage in German hangs above the door and on the wall. A few pedestrians, including two children and a man in a hat, stand along the street, which is unpaved or lightly paved and mostly empty of vehicles.
